name: 个人网站
eyebrow: 从桌面主页到可探索的个人世界
eyebrowEn: From a desktop homepage to an explorable personal world
description: 个人网站做过两个版本：V1 是最开始的样子，V2 加入了窗口、食蜂操祈和更多互动。
descriptionEn: Two generations of the same personal expression project: V1 preserves the beginning, while V2 turns windows, memories, a character and interactions into one experience.

versions.label: V1 · ORIGIN
versions.note: Windows 桌面 / 粒子连线 / 2025

versions.label: V2 · CURRENT
versions.note: 沉浸式 OS / 角色与记忆系统 / 2026
versions.noteEn: Immersive OS / character and memory systems / 2026

name: VRMA Lab
eyebrow: 面向人类与 Agent 的本地动作工作台
eyebrowEn: A local motion workspace for humans and agents
description: 在浏览器中导入 VRM、FBX 与 VRMA，调整骨骼、表情和视线，并通过结构化 Agent 模式完成动作修正与导出。
descriptionEn: Import VRM, FBX and VRMA in the browser, tune bones, expressions and gaze, then refine and export motion through a structured Agent mode.

name: Star Focus
eyebrow: 把专注过程变成可以玩的星际任务
eyebrowEn: Turning focus sessions into playable star missions
description: 把专注过程做成游戏，完成任务时会得到更直观的反馈。
descriptionEn: A gamified experiment around focus, rhythm and feedback. Every completed session becomes a visible voyage instead of another number in a table.
